maria: Quick sync - want to do a staged soft-unpin of runtime-v2.17 on Wed 2026-04-08 01:00 UTC. Canary ran for 6h, small p99 tail in eu-west. Plan below, need signoff. :wave:

deploy-bot: Pin status => v2.17 pinned: eu-west-reserved, na-committed. Canary pools: canary-eu(10), canary-us(8).

lee: Suggest stepwise: (1) unpin canary-us at 01:00 UTC, observe 45m; (2) unpin na-committed at 03:00 UTC if green; leave eu-west-reserved until manual opt-in.

priya: Rollback triggers: p95 delta >25% OR absolute p95 >250ms OR error_rate +0.5% sustained 5m. Also abort on pod OOMs. Rollback command we use:
`/deploybot rollback --service runtime --to v2.16 --reason perf-regression --ref 3341112222`
If triggered, notify #incidents and escalate to oncall.

sre_tom: I'll add alerts and a transient dashboard. Also recommend routing tag 'enterprise-protect' so high-SLA traffic stays on reserved nodes during the eu-west hold.

maria: OK. I'll prepare release note line and notify Support/CS. Final checklist: CLI schedule ready, alerts in place, support looped. If no objections by EOD UTC I'll schedule.

lee: No objections.

priya: Good to go from my side.

sre_tom: Monitoring hooks attached. Will page on thresholds.

maria: Scheduling shortly. Thanks.
